name: agroedge-mern
description: AgroEdge MERN Stack: MongoDB Atlas, Express.js, React 18 (Vite), Node.js with 2dsphere Geospatial AI & Outbreak Command Center

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const n = isWin ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; spawn(n, ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn(n, ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
